why: No major reviewer answers the above-the-laptop question directly. WIRED is the only one that names a tested product whose stand lifts it over the laptop screen (Espresso Lite 15), and Tom's Hardware merely notes such stands exist. The rest are general portable or desktop monitor roundups, an unreadable page, and two untested listicles. A focused page comparing every above-laptop mount option with prices and a pick would stand out, but it would compete with WIRED's tested partial answer.
